protocol.causal_order: for t: obtain causal expert predictions; predict with posterior from targets strictly before t; score target t; only then multiply posterior by expert likelihood of target t and renormalize
protocol.comparator: same neural and count experts, plus each seed's fixed mixture weight selected earlier on a separate official TUNE suffix
protocol.context: 64-input masked windows; every noninitial suffix byte once; count contexts reset with neural windows; blend posterior persists across windows

count_expert.smoothing_source: already frozen primary predictive_mixture fresh-TUNE selection; not selected on this TEST suffix

protocol.fresh_interval_selection: Fixed before reading this suffix; no alternate suffix after scores
protocol.guarantee: L_online=-log((1/K)*sum_alpha exp(-L_alpha)) <= min_alpha L_alpha + log(K), K=21, cumulative natural-log loss
protocol.method: Standard equal-prior Bayesian aggregation of 21 fixed convex neural/count mixtures; no novelty claim
protocol.neural_experts: All three retained fixed AdamW wikitext_byte baseline checkpoints; no seed selection or neural updates
protocol.online_adaptation: Past TEST targets update only mixture posterior, never expert parameters/counts. This is a causal online predictor, not a frozen-weight predictor.
protocol.online_prediction: posterior probability average of all fixed-grid experts, equivalent to mixture at prior-to-current-target posterior mean alpha
protocol.posterior_numerics: stable logsumexp with normalized log posterior; no clipping or target-dependent tuning
protocol.prior: equal 1/21 mass on every fixed grid weight, reset once at start of this new suffix
protocol.purpose: Prospective causal prediction and exact log-loss-regret audit on a new disjoint suffix
protocol.regret_reference: best fixed grid weight evaluated retrospectively only for audit; never used to choose online predictions
protocol.scope: Same dataset, one new32KiB interval, three frozen models. Universal log-loss bound needs positive target mass from at least one grid expert; empirical improvements do not establish superiority on new corpora.

source.stream: UTF-8 newline join of nonempty non-whitespace rows with terminal newline

protocol.test_policy: freeze protocol, dependencies and previous primary selection before first new TEST read; one pass per seed; no tuning after suffix scores
protocol.timing: report model load, TRAIN fit, count prediction, neural inference, frozen blending, online update/prediction and total wall seconds; shared CPU, no speedup claim
protocol.uncertainty: paired contiguous2048-target block bootstrap,10000draws,seed731923; average same-byte model losses before resampling; descriptive conditional on this suffix and these frozen models
